rows.t: │ ═══ Getting around ═══                                                                           │
│ Everything in AgeForge is a command: type it at the prompt at the bottom of the screen and press │
│ Enter. Panels open over the whole screen, and the prompt keeps working in most of them. The      │
│ Wonders, Harbinger and Build Plan panels use letter keys, so press Esc before you type a command │
│ there.                                                                                           │
│   PgUp/PgDn     - Scroll a panel that is longer than the screen, like this one                   │
│   Option+arrows - No Page Up, Page Down, Home or End on your keyboard? Option+Up and Option+Down │
│                   are PgUp and PgDn, and Option+Left and Option+Right are Home and End, in every │
│                   panel. Alt does the same on other keyboards                                    │
│   Esc           - Close the panel (with no panel open: save and go to the main menu)             │
│   Tab           - Finish the word you are typing (press again for the next match)                │
│   help          - Open this page again at any time                                               │
│ New here? Try: build hut, then status, then research. Each panel below lists its own keys.       │
│ ═══ The dashboard ═══                                                                            │
│ With no panel open.                                                                              │
│   PgUp/PgDn - Scroll the Buildings list                                                          │
│   Ctrl+R    - The next page of the Resources box, when it has more than it can show              │
│   Esc       - Save and go to the main menu (with a panel open: close it)                         │
│ ═══ The prompt ═══                                                                               │
│ As you type, the best completion shows in dim text after the cursor.                             │
│   Tab   - Take the completion; press again for the next one                                      │
│   →     - Take the completion (cursor at the end of the line)                                    │
│ ↑↓ scroll · PgUp PgDn page · Esc close · or type a command                                       │
